nodes.label: Input: nums, threshold; init i=0, ans=0
nodes.action: ctx['nums'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['threshold'] = ctx['arg1']; ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums']); ctx['i'] = 0; ctx['ans'] = 0

nodes.label: j < n and nums[j] <= threshold and parity alternates?
nodes.logic: ctx['j'] < ctx['n'] and ctx['nums'][ctx['j']] <= ctx['threshold'] and ctx['nums'][ctx['j']] % 2 != ctx['nums'][ctx['j'] - 1] % 2

nodes.label: ans = max(ans, j - i); i = j
nodes.action: ctx['ans'] = max(ctx['ans'], ctx['j'] - ctx['i']); ctx['i'] = ctx['j']
